First, we apply the distributive law.

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{3}(3a+6b)+2a & = \\ (\frac{1}{3})\cdot 3a+(\frac{1}{3})\cdot 6b+2a & = \\ \frac{3a}{3}+\frac{6b}{3}+2a & = \\ a+2b+2a & \end{aligned}
$$

Then, we collect and combine the like terms, simplifying the coefficients as much as possible.

$$
\begin{aligned}a+2b+2a & = \\ a+2a+2b & = \\ 3a+2b & \end{aligned}
$$
